params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters the results to include only those usage records that were completed on or after the specified date. This parameter sets the start date for the filter.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters the results to include only those usage records that were completed on or before the specified date. This parameter sets the end date for the filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies the page number of the results to retrieve. The page parameter is used to request a specific page of the results, starting from `1` (the first page). If not provided, the default is to return the first page of results.

items.docs:
Lists all charge sessions completed by a fleet's managed vehicles on the Chargefox network. You can specify
      a date range to filter results. Both date parameters can be used together to define a period, or individually to filter usage records from or until a specific date. The returned list is a paginated set of 100 results per page.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters the results to include only those invoice records that were invoiced on or after the specified date. This parameter sets the start date for the filter.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters the results to include only those invoice records that were invoiced on or before the specified date. This parameter sets the end date for the filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies the page number of the results to retrieve. The page parameter is used to request a specific page of the results, starting from `1` (the first page). If not provided, the default is to return the first page of results.

items.docs: Lists all invoices for a fleet's organisation. This includes both fleet and site host invoices. You can specify a date range to filter results. Both date parameters can be used together to define a period, or individually to filter invoices from or until a specific date. The returned list is a paginated set of 100 results per page.
